title: SDoH-Aware Narrative Anchoring Bias in Medical LLMs for Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation using the NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA dataset, measuring model accuracy and answer consistency across different persona-based patient narratives that vary in social context, speech style, and perceived barriers to access, while keeping the underlying clinical facts and correct answers fixed.
